selection_policy: Choose a source-verifiable closed bug with a merged fix, a resolvable immediate pre-fix commit, an observable scenario that does not require disclosing implementation locations, and a multi-step causal explanation. Selection uses no baseline/treatment outcomes. Retain the whole candidate audit.

tasks.source_policy: Full git archive of commit, no .git, no submodule initialization or generated artifacts; identical exported source in both arms. Record actual indexed file coverage.
forbidden_corpus_markers: Keep the recovered WAL attached to the segment.

predeclared_metrics.quality_guard: Compare costs alongside QA quality; retain all failed/low-quality runs, with successful-pair-only costs explicitly labeled as conditional.
predeclared_metrics.inference_scope: Single-case development pilot; no population-wide significance or contamination-free claim.
